#!/usr/bin/env sh
# `pnpm test:affected`: the same selection as `typecheck:affected` (ISS-11856).
set -u

if ! filter=$(sh "$(dirname "$0")/affected-filter.sh"); then
    printf 'test:affected: %s; nothing was selected.\n' "$filter" >&2
    exit 1
fi

TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-2}
export TURBO_CONCURRENCY
exec turbo test --filter="$filter" "$@"
